violation_type.title: AP Safety Precautions for Swimming Pools-Ensure child wearing PFD (26 TAC §744.3409(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: AP Safety Precautions for Swimming Pools-Ensure child wearing PFD
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation failed to ensure a child deemed unable to swim without assistance was wearing a life vest during a swimming activity.  This resulted in the lifeguard needing to rescue the child when they wandered into a portion of the pool where they were unable to stand.
